title: Nift machine-readable diagnostics, schema 1 (D-022)
description: One JSON object per line on stderr when --format=json or NIFT_FORMAT=json is set. Either a diagnostic record or a summary record. See docs/runtime-2/diagnostics-schema.md.

code.description: Stable identity from the src/Diagnostic.h taxonomy (domain.name), or a user.* code carried by a thrown Error. Never encodes catchability or severity.

source.description: Where the text came from; `file` uses `file`.

file.description: The path exactly as text mode prints it (absolute for scripts and imports, project-relative in build diagnostics); null unless source is file.

column.description: 1-based byte column, as in text mode.

end_column.description: 1-based byte column one past the last byte of the span.

name.description: Function, method, module path, page name; `<top>` for the unit's top level.

call_site.description: Where this frame was entered from (the call expression in the caller); null for the outermost frame or when the engine cannot tell (frames_complete=false).

catchable.description: Whether a try/catch around this raise would have caught it, under the language rules in force (today: recoverable operational failures and user throws). Separate from code and severity.

message.description: Message without legacy compatibility prefixes (return: , import: , thread: , lambda body error: ...); those are expressed by frames.

span.description: Primary span: the failing expression (D-018c); null only for diagnostics with no source position (e.g. a missing script file).

entry.description: The entry unit (script path, page source, or null for -e/eval).

page.description: Tracked page name for build diagnostics.

phase.description: validate = reported by syntax prevalidation before anything ran (D-022 #3).

engine.description: Engine that ran the unit; none when validation failed.

frames.description: Innermost first: frames[0] is the function containing the span. At most 64 entries (first 32 and last 32).

frames_complete.description: false when the engine could not record every call site (legacy evaluator).

cause.description: Cause chain of a thrown Error, outermost cause first.

text.description: The exact text-mode rendering of this diagnostic (byte-identical to what text mode prints, without colour); may span lines (build diagnostics).
